# Cases whose comparison with the node oracle is not "ok" (see expect_test.go).
# id<TAB>status<TAB>reason
aggregated--beyond-ascii	differ	platform-dependent reference, not an engine rule: 日本語 has no glyph in any font the oracle registers, so Pango measures an unknown glyph. On Linux (hermetic fontconfig) that is pangocairo's hex box (pangocairo-font.c, get_glyph_extents_missing): 5*pad_x + 2*(digit_width + pad_x) pixels, with pad_x and digit_width taken from FreeType-hinted metrics of the main and a 'monospace' mini font (29 px per glyph at 9px DejaVu Sans, against the engine's .notdef advance of 0.75 em); on macOS node-canvas registers fonts through CoreText, ignores the fontconfig file, and the glyph falls back to a system CJK font (9.198 px at 9px; the 8 px here). The engine models neither: the hex box digit widths at a 4 to 5 px mini font are the hinter's output, not derivable from outlines
